definitions: 犹豫的；迟疑的；不愿马上做某事的（常用结构：be hesitant to do sth.）

examples.text: Though this remake has been heavily rumored for a long time, I've been hesitant to talk about it before an official confirmation. Well, that confirmation's here.
examples.explanation: 这里的 hesitant 表示“犹豫的、迟疑的”。说话者在官方确认之前一直不太愿意谈论这个重制版，因为消息还没有确定。

source.text: Ocarina of Time Remake Trailer Analysis
